text:
Noah Kim: flagging a new duplicate-report from onboarding sample when hitting 429 during token refresh. Sequence: client refreshes creds mid-POST, upstream 429, immediate retry created a second resource.

Fiona Grant: thanks. which SDK/sample & repro?

Noah Kim: java-sdk v2.0.1 + sample-app v0.9. We do set Idempotency-Key in the app but the auth replay rebuild drops it. Logs:
2026-05-10T12:04:01Z INFO POST /v1/create id=req_77
2026-05-10T12:04:01Z WARN auth refresh start
2026-05-10T12:04:02Z ERROR upstream 429
2026-05-10T12:04:02Z INFO retrying id=req_77 headers(Idempotency-Key)=<missing>
2026-05-10T12:04:02Z INFO POST /v1/create id=req_77

Luca Bianchi: repeating pattern across languages. We fixed whitelist bugs elsewhere but want a more robust approach than just passing headers. Idea: introduce a short-lived client-side "replay token" that the SDK attaches to mutating requests when Idempotency-Key is absent. The server can echo a header like `X-Replay-Safe-Until` indicating how long it will dedupe identical payloads.

Fiona Grant: interesting. So flow: SDK generates Replay-Token (UUID) when issuing POST without Idempotency-Key, stores hash(method+path+body)->token for TTL (e.g., 20s). If a retry occurs within TTL, SDK reattaches same token. Server uses token + body hash to detect duplicate. Server can set `X-Replay-Safe-Until: 163` (seconds) to extend server dedupe window if it supports it.

Noah Kim: yes. benefit: protects against header-drop in auth replay, works across network retries, avoids forcing users to add Idempotency-Key immediately.

Luca Bianchi: also propose SDK config knobs: { replayWindowMs: number, preserveHeaders: string[], strictRetries: boolean }. Default strictRetries=false. If strictRetries=true SDK refuses to retry POST/PUT without Idempotency-Key (safe opt-in for security-conscious teams).

Fiona Grant: for 429 backoff, standardize on full jitter: sleep = rand(0, min(maxBackoff, base * 2^attempt)). base=200ms, maxBackoff=5s. Also add a small clincher: if server returns `X-Replay-Safe-Until`, SDK should prefer local dedupe and reduce retry aggression.

Noah Kim: QA notes: add unit test for auth-refresh + 429 that asserts only one backend create; integration test to run sample apps (java/node/python) with gateway header-drop simulated. Also add telemetry events: sdk.replay.token_generated, sdk.replay.reused, sdk.replay.strict_blocked, sdk.replay.header_dropped.

ops-bot: Created ticket DEX-4999: "sdk: replay-token + server `X-Replay-Safe-Until` handshake, preserve headers, strictRetries flag" https://redwood.atlassian/browse/DEX-4999 :white_check_mark:

Luca Bianchi: follow-up: check streaming resume path and any long-polling reconnections that reuse auth-replay logic. If header-drop possible there too, open DEX-5000.

Fiona Grant: I'll draft a short RFC tomorrow with API sketches and a proposed server header. Good first-class fix that avoids changing user code immediately.

Noah Kim: awesome — thanks. I'll attach logs and repro harness to the ticket.
